coverage_notes: The immutable anchors cover the trade-controls, controlled-input, supported-territory, and continued-use update rules.

Section 16.5 imposes contractual notice-delivery requirements, and Section 16.7 restricts assignment and specifies permitted assignment paths. These are operative but do not fit any supplied activity and object without misrepresenting them.

Section 16.13(a) requires OpenAI to give notice of updates, with different timing rules for updates materially affecting Customer’s rights or obligations and updates needed to comply with law. This provider notice duty cannot be faithfully represented by a supplied activity and object.

paragraph_audit.reason: The anchors cover the trade-control rules, geographic access restriction, and acceptance by continued use after an effective update. Section 16.5’s notice-delivery requirements, Section 16.7’s assignment restrictions and permitted assignment paths, and Section 16.13(a)’s OpenAI update-notice duty remain operative but cannot be represented faithfully using the supplied activities and objects. Other provisions in this paragraph are agreement mechanics, rights statements, or liability and dispute-resolution terms outside this activity-constraint extraction.
